name: 55436 · Edina, MN
findings: ZIP 55436 (Edina) has 87 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55436 (Edina) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 55436 (Edina) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.
